crossRefs.note: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
and saying, “Where is the promise of his coming? For, from the day that the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as…
God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.
The man gave names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field; but for man there…
He created them male and female, and blessed them. On the day they were created, he named them Adam.
Yet you say, ‘Why?’ Because Yahweh has been witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have dealt…

translations.web: But from the beginning of the creation, God made them male and female.
translations.bsb: However, from the beginning of creation, ‘God made them male and female.’
translations.kjv: But from the beginning of the creation God made them male and female.
translations.asv: But from the beginning of the creation, Male and female made he them.
